item.title: August 2026 General Meeting: HHA Night at the Theatre
item.description:
Tuesday, August 11, 2026 at 6:30 PM

Location: alley theatre, 615 Texas Ave, Houston, tx, 77002

Join us for the Houston Heights Association General Meeting on Wednesday, August 11 at 7:30 PM for a special community night out: HHA Night at the Theatre! We are heading to the Alley Theatre for a thrilling performance of The Girl on the Train. Come early to mix, mingle, and sip a drink with your neighbors before the show begins. Ticket Information: To join our neighborhood block, visit www.alleytheatre.org/the-girl-on-the-train. Be sure to enter the coupon code HHA before choosing your performance date to access our special community arrangement. Event Details: Date: Wednesday, August 11, 2026 Time: 7:30 PM Venue: Alley Theatre Website: www.alleytheatre.org/the-girl-on-the-train

item.title: Heights Garden Club Presents: Angel Wing Arts brings this Bee Watering Station Craft to the Heights Garden Club
item.description:
Wednesday, August 26, 2026 at 6:30 PM

Location: Houston Heights City Hall & Fire Station, 107 W. 12th Street, Houston, TX, 77008, United States

AUGUST 26th at 6:30pm, join us at the Heights Fire Station Carolyn, of Angel Wing Arts, (Instagram @cacoatesart or @anglewingarts) and one of our own, will lead this workshop. Carolyn has been active in the arts for over 30 years, from faux finishes to murals to art pieces. She has worked with clients and their art needs, and her work itself is whimsical and fun. Please join us on August 26, at our favorite spot to mingle, the historic Heights Fire station on 12th and Yale streets. There will be a demo, and plenty of inspiration to kick off your creativity!! Each participant will construct two bee watering stations from clay pots and saucers and then decorate them with paints and pens, as seen in the photo. Let’s help our bees and butterflies in this heat by providing them a safe place to get a drink that YOU are providing with your cute, personalized vessel. Reserve your spot through Sign-Up Genius so we have an accurate headcount and can make sure we have the right amount of supplies on hand. But hurry, there is only room for 25 guests and the deadline to sign up is August 19th. $20 cash per person, ages 12 and up, to be paid at the door. Please, no unaccompanied minors. Doors opens at 6:30pm, Class is 7-9pm. Please arrive early so that instruction can begin on time. Water and some light refreshments will be provided, but please consider bringing a snack to share, if you are so inclined. You may bring your own adult beverages if you wish.  

From Houston Heights Association
